english.title: Holder of licence / medical certificate / declaration fail to cause licence / certificate / declaration to be produced
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a

(A)_[licence granted or rendered valid under the Air Navigation Order 2016,]_
(B)_[licence granted or rendered valid by the CAA under the Aircrew Regulation,]_
(C)_[medical certificate required under articles 160 or 162 of the Air Navigation Order 2016,]_
(D)_[medical declaration under article 163 of the Air Navigation Order 2016,]_

failed, within a reasonable time after being requested to do so by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an authorised person, to cause

(E)_[the licence, including a certificate of validation issued under article 169 of the order]_
(F)_[the medical certificate]_
(G)_[the medical declaration]_

to be produced to that person
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 235(4) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the holder of a licence granted or rendered valid under the Air Navigation Order 2016 OR
licence granted or rendered valid by the CAA under the Aircrew Regulation OR
medical certificate required under articles 160 or 162 of the Air Navigation Order 2016 OR
medical declaration under article 163 of the Air Navigation Order 2016,
failed, within a reasonable time after being requested to do so by an authorised person, to cause
the licence, including a certificate of validation issued under article 169 of the order, the medical certificate or the medical declaration
to be produced to that person
